findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a design artboard uses a 200 ms entry fade with `@starting-style`.
The renderer captures as soon as page load and `document.fonts.ready` finish, but [font readiness](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/FontFaceSet/ready) does not wait for the transition. The published PNG can therefore show faded or invisible content. The previous renderer supplied a 2000 ms virtual-time budget, and the current screenshot tests check dimensions rather than the rendered content.
Adds work: settle entry transitions before capture; F 2 x H 2 = 4; 2 x C = 4
findings.title: Preserve settled design screenshots

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Test
Case: normal use - preparing a release after a merged change updates a generated template.
The release test checks version text in the checkout's hooks and workflow, then runs `forge sync` in a separate fixture repo. `tests/test_split_ships.py:62` likewise checks a fixture. Neither verifies that this checkout's generated files match their sources: for example, leaving `.forge/design/support.js` stale would pass these checks, even though `src/forge/story.py:91` identifies it as generated output. Add a check of the release checkout's synced files.
